description: Tests that fail only on the Windows CI leg (KRN-02; Windows is supported for development). Every entry is scoped with "platforms": ["win32"]. Recorded from reading the tests, not from a Windows run: the first run of the test-windows job confirms or corrects each entry. A test of a POSIX-only fact (file modes, chmod-denied directories, graceful signals, /bin/sh) states its platform with a win32 skip instead of an entry here; what remains is owned by a later package: the filesystem package by CNT-17. No entry may name core/test/app, core/test/cli or a starter (scripts/test/windows-ledger.test.mjs).

test: refuses a stream whose temp file cannot be written, without crashing the process
entries.reason: The test denies access with chmod 0o000/0o555 on a directory; Windows maps chmod to the read-only attribute, which does not stop listing or creating files in a directory, so the expected EACCES never happens.
